summary: Validated both new features and requested regressions through the public endpoint and browser UI. TEST-lead filtering correctly excluded name, email, remark, and TEST LEADS-stage rows while retaining Latest Kumar; disabling the setting retained all rows. Cumulative all-time/custom/future ranges, range export, sample matrix, spend patches, trends, date presets, tabs, settings persistence, Dashboard, Compare, Report, and History passed. One API input-validation edge case remains.

minor.issue: Date query parameters are unvalidated strings. start=not-a-date and a reversed range (start=2026-12-31&end=2026-01-01) both return HTTP 200 with a misleading empty Custom Report instead of a 4xx validation response. The export endpoint shares the same builder.

design_issues.screen: Report Till Date date range and Generate Report week date
issues: Date selection uses browser-native input[type=date] controls rather than the existing shadcn calendar/date-picker pattern, giving browser-dependent UX.

action_items: Type cumulative start/end as validated ISO dates and reject malformed or start-after-end ranges with a meaningful 4xx response; apply the same validation to range export.
Replace native date inputs with the shadcn calendar/date-range picker for consistent UX.
Add catch/finally and a retryable visible error state to CumulativeView and other initial API loads so a rejected request cannot leave an indefinite loading skeleton.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py defines _build_cumulative twice (lines 201 and 219); the first definition is dead and should be removed to prevent maintenance errors.
Cumulative start/end and uploaded report week_date are plain strings compared lexicographically. Use Pydantic date types and enforce start <= end before querying/aggregation.
CumulativeView.load sets loading true but has no try/catch/finally, so network or validation failures cause an unhandled rejection and permanent skeleton.

success_rate.backend: 88.9% (8/9 pytest cases; all explicitly requested backend scenarios passed, one invalid-range edge case failed)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested functional flows passed with no console errors or warnings

seed_data_creation: Created two TEST-filter upload reports and one sample report during API testing; all were deleted by teardown. Global settings were changed to verify persistence and restored to exclude_test_leads=true/test_keywords=['test']. The two pre-existing ready sample reports were preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run backend_test.py after adding typed date/range-order validation; test_09 should pass. Functional coverage confirmed raw_rows=6, excluded=4, kept=2 when enabled and excluded=0/kept=6 when disabled. Browser E2E confirmed custom-range title/KPIs/program+publisher tabs/export URL, settings reload persistence, Compare charts/table, Report publisher panel, History, and clean console. Production yarn build compiled successfully.
rca_of_the_issue: The cumulative endpoints declare start/end as Optional[str], and _build_cumulative compares report week_date strings directly without parsing or range-order validation. Therefore malformed and reversed inputs are treated as legitimate filters and produce empty reports with HTTP 200 rather than client errors.
